facts.text: NChainEnv is a chain of n states and the agent always starts in state s2
In state s1 the reward is 0.001 and in state sN it is 1
The action space is Discrete(2): the integer actions 0 and 1
Action 1 moves right (the state is incremented) and any other action moves left (the state is decremented); the state stays at the ends of the chain
The reward is computed from the state before the transition
The reward is 1.0 when the state is n-1 and the action is 1, 0.001 when the state is 0 and the action is 0, and 0 otherwise
The observation is the vector (v <= state), as uint8: 1 for the states up to and including the current state and 0 for the rest
The observation is evaluated over v = arange(n) in reset and step
The observation space is Box(low=0, high=1, shape=(n,), dtype=uint8)
The step limit is max_steps = n + 8
The episode terminates when the step counter reaches max_steps
A reset sets the state to 1 and the step counter to 0 and returns the initial observation
reset calls super().reset(seed=seed) to seed np_random; NChainEnv draws no random numbers, so the seed changes nothing in the chain
NChain-v1 is registered with entry_point gym_exploration.envs:NChainEnv

gaps: the environment is a discrete Markov chain: no continuous dynamics, forces, contacts, actuators, sensors or noise model
no fixed physics timestep: a tick is one discrete transition, so timestep_ms is 0 (an event-driven analytic model) and realtime_factor 0 means the chain is not wall-clock paced
the bridge auto-resets a fresh episode after a terminal or truncated step (autoreset=True); the upstream NChainEnv itself does not auto-reset, and the step receipt still reports the terminal flags

the fake backend re-implements the chain in pure Python and was not compared with the upstream environment (gymnasium and numpy were not importable where the gate ran); the fake returns lists of Python ints where upstream returns numpy uint8 arrays
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
